name: Riogordo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light green, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Riogordo (a cross and a tree on green above a bridge and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Riogordo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
